desc:
It's a fun and fast-paced word game!

[🥊] Take turns creating a new word that starts with the last letter of the previous word.
[🚫] The same word can't be used twice.
[🔥] Build winning streaks with quick thinking and a strong vocabulary.
[⚡] Outsmart your opponents and be the last player standing!

👍 If you enjoy the game, don't forget to like and favorite it to support us!
🛠️ Features may change, and you may encounter unexpected bugs.

Using exploits or cheats will result in a permanent ban.
